decisions.statement: No store is stated here, so a session is held in the cookie alone.
Google is the one provider a person signs in with.
A sign-in is reached by the name its provider and its subject hash make.
An address reaches a contributor only where the provider's name for that person reaches none.
A contributor one sign-in already reaches refuses a second sign-in.
No address a person signs in under is written to a page here.

definition: Better Auth reached from a React Router app, with Google the one provider
